timings.note:
Paired root-search pilot on an idle GPU, using the audit's frozen binaries.

The configurations have equal candidate/refinement quotas, not equal cell caps
or elapsed time. Measure their actual costs before designing equal-time searches.
Each repetition must reproduce the first pool/export and pass resultant checks.
timings.caveat: Idle checks are between runs; no claim of exclusive hardware reservation. Process timings exclude the separate independent scoring study.

settings.note: Factor-base limits recorded for future test sieving; model uses LPB, region and q range.

quality.note:
Independently score all 200 exports per pilot mode, then validate leaders.

Standard MurphyE uses 16k search/64k evaluation angles, then 256k at fixed skew.
The provisional job lattice uses stream 0 for screening and streams 2/3 for
validation. These model comparisons are not measured relation yields.
quality.caveat: Equal 4096-candidate refinement and 200-export scoring quotas. Timing/quality pilot, not an equal-elapsed-time or holdout study. Lattice skew is optimized for job-bounds MurphyE, not directly for lattice yield.
